"'''Proctor Six'''" was the codename for a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who had amassed a wealth of valuable intel on the most influential leaders of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Broken Broker}}</ref>
